reasoning: Hero JsTs IP BTN on 8c5d2h rainbow flop, both opponents checked. This is air with backdoor flush + backdoor straight - no made hand. Two backdoors and overcards do not justify a bet into two players who haven't shown weakness on this board. Check and realize.

Hero KhJh OOP SB on Ac9d3s rainbow, 3-way. Air bucket with backdoor flush draw + KJ overcards. OOP into two opponents on an Ace-high board favouring the BTN opener. Per KB §1.5 and DO NOT Rule 2, semi-bluffs require nut draws + blockers; backdoors and overcards alone do not. Check and fold to a bet.

Hero Td9d on Jd8d3h facing CO bet 33 into 90. Drawing hand: flush draw + open-ended straight draw (12+ outs combo). Pot odds 26.8% met by huge equity (~52% combined draw equity + reverse-implied). KB §1.7: non-nut flush draw should call, not raise. OOP semi-bluff into 2 opponents fails fold-equity threshold (DO NOT Rule 2). Call and realize equity.

Hero 9s8s on QsJd5h2c6c river, IP BTN, BB checks, no facing bet. Hero has missed OESD and only 9-high - air with no showdown value. Bluffing river 3-way against two opponents who reached river with showdown-quality hands is unprofitable per §1.4 (1:4 bluff:value). Check and give up.

Hero AdKs on Jd8d4c facing CO bet 33 into 90, 3-way. Air with nut overcards + backdoor flush draw (Ad on 2-flush). Per Worked Example 7: 6 overcard outs (~24%) plus pot odds 26.8% make this a profitable call. Not a §1.7 raise - hero has no flush draw, just one diamond and two overcards. Call and realize equity.

Hero Qd3d on Jd8d4c facing CO bet 33 into 90. Drawing hand with non-nut flush draw (Q-high). KB §1.7 explicitly excludes non-nut flush draws from RAISE - call or fold only. 9 flush outs ~36% by river, pot odds 26.8% met. Call to realize draw equity; do not raise into 2 opponents with non-nut FD.

Hero Tc9c flopped nut straight on QhJs8d, IP BTN, both check. Monster bucket - flopped nut straight on a wet board. Per Worked Example 4 + KB §1.7: monsters MUST bet 3-way to deny equity to live draws (KQ, AT, flush draws on turn). Bet 66% to charge draws and build pot.

Hero QhJc top-two on Qc8d3s rainbow, IP BTN, 3-way checked through. Strong-made (TPGK on dry board, hero has Q kicker beating most Qx). Per DO NOT Rule 5 + Worked Example 6 inversions: dry rainbow + 3-way checked-through + IP + value-strong made hand = thin value bet. Small sizing (25-33%) extracts from worse Qx and pocket pairs.

Hero QsJd top pair on Qc8d3s rainbow, OOP SB, 3-way. Mirror of MW-23 but OOP. Worked Example 6: even OOP, when board is dry rainbow + villain ranges are wide and air-heavy + hero is near top of own range, BET is correct. Hero acts first - betting takes initiative. Small 25-33% sizing.

Hero JhJc overpair on 9d6c2h rainbow, IP BTN, 3-way checked through. Strong-made (overpair top-of-range on disconnected dry board). Per Worked Example 4 logic: pocket pair stronger than top pair on a wet-leaning board (96 connectedness, draws live) - protection bet 33-50% to deny equity to overcards and 87/T8 type draws. Sets/2pair are rare; villain mostly worse pairs and air.

Hero JhJd overpair on 9d6c2h rainbow, OOP SB, 3-way. Mirror of MW-27 but OOP. Overpair on semi-connected board needs protection from overcards (T-A) and gutshot/OESD draws. OOP defaults toward CHECK but here villain ranges are wide-passive and hero's overpair has clear value-extraction targets. Bet 33% pot.

Hero KcTh top pair on KdJc6s facing CO bet 35 + BTN call, BB. Solver-corrected reversal anchor (reference_corrections.md): KT has 40% equity vs 18.4% pot odds. Bet+call narrows ranges but composition triple shows villain TP+ ~32% (not heavy), and KT dominates worse Kx, middle pairs, weaker broadways in remainder. Equity surplus too large for fold; KT calls per Worked Example 3 corrected version.

Hero 8h8s flopped middle set on 8d7c3h facing CO bet 40 + BTN call, 3-way. Monster bucket. Reversal anchor: sets MUST raise vs bet+call multiway because (a) board is wet (76, 65, 9x straight draws + 2 hearts backdoor), (b) protection vs draws getting correct price, (c) value extraction from Kx, AK overcards calling and worse made hands. Slowplaying lets free turns hit straights. Raise to ~140-160 (3-4x).

Hero AcAd overpair on Js9c4d, CO hero c-bets into 3-way checked board. PFA, strong-made/monster overpair on connected two-tone-ish board. Two opponents = two chances to draw - protection critical. Per KB §1.3 (3-way c-bet 43% with strong range) and Worked Example 4 logic: AA on JT9 type wet board must bet small-to-medium to charge draws and extract from Jx, 9x, pocket pairs. 33-50% sizing.

Hero QcJd TPSK on Qh7c2s rainbow facing CO bet 9 into 27 (SPR ~3, low SPR). Medium-made/strong on dry board. Pot odds 25%, hero equity ~60% (top pair good kicker on dry rainbow). Low SPR commits stack on a flop call - but hero beats CO's c-bet range often (KQ, AQ ahead but villain has few combos vs JT-Tx-7x-22-pairs). Call; raising bloats pot OOP-ish vs strong CO range with KQ/AQ ahead.

Hero QcJd TPSK on Qh7c2s rainbow facing CO bet 33 into 90 (SPR ~8, standard). Standard SPR allows call-and-evaluate. Pot odds 26.8% met by ~60% equity. KB DO NOT Rule 5: TPSK is medium-strength 3-way - call to control pot, fold to turn aggression. Raising into CO's bet-into-3 range loses to AQ/KQ, folds out worse.

Hero QcJd TPSK on Qh7c2s rainbow facing CO bet 15 into 45, SPR ~15 deep. Pot odds 25%. Deep SPR makes implied odds with TPSK worse (reverse-implied vs AQ/KQ on later streets). Still a call - hero ahead of villain's c-bet range majority (Kx air, 88-TT, 7x). Plan to check turn unimproved; fold to turn-and-river barrels.

Hero AhJh nut FD on Kh8h3d facing BB lead 15 into 30, SPR ~3, IP BTN. Drawing - nut flush draw + Ah blocker + J overcard. KB §1.7: nut FD + nut blocker + side equity = RAISE candidate. SPR ~3 means raise commits - but IP semi-bluff with nut blocker into a leading BB (capped, often draw or weak made) gives high fold equity from the bettor and fold-out of the still-to-act SB if any. Raise to ~45 (3x). Note v3.2 OVERRIDE applies: must check villain_air_pct >= 0.20.

Hero AhJh nut FD on Kh8h3d facing CO bet 33 into 90, SPR ~15 deep, IP BTN. v3.2 KB §1.7 OVERRIDE: when villain_air_pct < 0.20 (CO c-bet into 3-way, range is value-heavy, air ~5%), nut FD with blocker prefers CALL not RAISE. Fold equity insufficient. 9 flush outs + 6 overcard outs + gutshot to broadway = ~50% combined equity, easy call vs 26.8% pot odds. Realize draw equity vs CO's continuing range.

Hero QhTc on KsQdc7c-Jh turn facing CO barrel 60 into 200, IP BTN. Medium-made (2nd pair) + open-ended straight draw (any 9 or A makes the straight; gutshot to broadway via T). 8 clean outs + showdown value of pair of Qs + IP. Per Worked Example 8: draw equity survives multi-street aggression. Pot odds 23.1% met. Call and evaluate river.

Hero Th8h on Ts9h4d-7c turn facing BB double-lead 70 into 180, IP BTN. Medium-made (TPGK) + OESD (any 6 or J for straight, 8 outs). BB double-leading 3-way is a strong line but hero has top pair + 8 straight outs + heart backdoor. Equity ~38-42%, pot odds 28%. Per Worked Example 8: combined made + draw equity calls multi-street aggression. Call, plan to evaluate river.

Hero AhTc on QdJc4s rainbow flop, OOP BB, 3-way, low SPR ~2. Air with gutshot (any K) + 2 overcards. SPR 2 = stack-off territory. KB §1.6: low SPR commits stack on a bet - hero cannot bet a gutshot+overcards profitably 3-way OOP because (a) called by all better, folded by air only, (b) bet+call commits 50%+ stack with 30% equity. Check; call one bet for the gutshot draw equity at correct price.

Hero AdKd TPTK on As9c5d-Tc turn, IP BTN, 3-way after flop bet+2-calls. Strong-made (TPTK with K kicker on Ace-high). Both opponents checked turn after calling flop = weakness. Don't fear the T overcard — TPTK still beats vast majority of continuing range.

Hero JcTc TPGK on Js8h4d-5c turn facing BTN turn bet 90 into 220 after BTN raised flop. Reversal anchor: action history overrides equity. Flop raise + turn barrel from BTN = polarized to overpairs (QQ+), 2pair (J8/J4/84), sets, and J9s/J7s for bluff. JT is dominated by every value combo and beats only the bluffs. Pot odds 29% but hero's true equity vs the narrowed continuing range is below pot odds. Fold per DO NOT Rule 3 + MW-50 reversal anchor pattern.
